sources.title: Standard Ebooks, The Kural: Or, The Maxims of Thiruvalluvar (V. V. S. Aiyar), epub of 2024-04-15
sources.lineage_group: L-aiyar-wikisource (typed by Standard Ebooks from the English Wikisource page, a transcription of Internet Archive in.ernet.dli.2015.102804)
sources.rights_note: Supplies kurals 6-10 and 36-40, which the scan of the 1916 book lacks (tier typed_edition_only), and is a second witness for the rest of the layer. Its imprint: 'The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain ... They may still be copyrighted in other countries ... The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication.' The translation is Aiyar's (published 1916, d. 1925). Standard Ebooks modernises some spellings and the Wikisource typing has its own slips: it is never the authority where the scan has the page.
